name: model-annotations
title: Model Annotations
description: Labels pinned to points on a 3D model that follow them as the model turns, each a button that opens its note, hidden while its point is behind the camera or out of view; the same notes are always given as a list, so nobody has to find them by turning.

meta.when: Pointing out parts of a 3D object: the parts of a machine, features of a building, finds on a scan. Put the tracker inside the scene and the labels over it, in the same positioned box. For a flat picture use hotspots; for a model with no notes use model-viewer.
meta.example: const store = useAnnotationStore();
